Tandoor Recipes environment (REA)

earakely-scale/TandoorRecipesEnv-REA

Answer factual questions about seeded Tandoor Recipes data by calling replayed API tools, graded by whether the reply contains the recorded value.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • tool-calling QA over a replayed web app API
  • held-out eval of small tool-calling models

Reward

How it is scored
Exact match
Signal
Pass or fail

Answers a factual question by calling recorded API tools; reward 1 if the response contains the recorded value, else 0.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

uv tool install agentenv-framework --with 'agentenv-hf @ git+https://github.com/earakely-scale/agentenv-hf-plugin@v0.3.0'
agent-env hf run earakely-scale/TandoorRecipesEnv-REA --bundle tandoor --eval tandoor-retrieval --model openai/gpt-oss-120b:groq

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download earakely-scale/TandoorRecipesEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir TandoorRecipesEnv-REA

Needs: Docker and a model endpoint (a Hugging Face token works).
